description: Given a token contract address, find every supported network the token exists on and its OFT bridge contract on each. Useful to discover where a token can be bridged from and to before resolving a specific route.

fromChain.description: Optional network key to start the scan from (e.g. "bsc"). Auto-detected if omitted.

token.description: The token contract address (0x…). Works on any of the supported networks.

name: scan_token_networks
